prompt: Locked-off tripod shot, the camera does not move. A quiet, empty technology studio at night. Distant city lights twinkle gently through the window and a few far windows switch softly on and off. The blue glow behind the monitor breathes slowly, a little brighter then softer, as if the system is working. The tiny status lights on the small server box blink calmly. The desk, the laptops, the lamp and everything else stay perfectly still. No people, no text. Calm, slow, cinematic, seamless loop.
